title: About
text: Wooden Man Weather is a Marquette-focused weather dashboard and Monday work-week briefing. The dashboard shows National Weather Service forecasts, active alerts, and rolling twelve-month comparisons of temperature, precipitation, and snowfall against NOAA 1991–2020 normals for station USW00094850.

title: About
text:
How it updates
The site is built with Quarto and published to GitHub Pages. A GitHub Actions workflow renders the project on pushes to main and on a daily schedule so forecasts and climate caches stay current without a Shiny server.

title: About
text:
Attribution
Forecast and alert data: National Weather Service. Historical observations and normals: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. This is an independent project and is not endorsed by NOAA or the NWS.

title: Weekly outdoor outlook
text:
Wooden Man tasks
Outdoor first, tied to this 7-day forecast. Foul stretches get an indoor backup. No traffic tips — this is Marquette.









Task
Guidance




Sunday is the wind day
Dry enough to be out, breezy enough to feel it — up toward 25 mph on Sunday. Kite at Presque Isle if you have one; otherwise lean into the lake wind on a shore-path bench. Board folks: watch the lower harbor / Ore Dock even if you stay ashore.


Buck up for winter
Superior season is turning — get ready before the first lasting lake-effect cycle owns the calendar. Stage scrapers and a warm layer by the door; check heat (furnace, baseboard, or wood); cabin folks: woodpile and roof edges; renters: same idea in apartment scale. Enjoy the mild days, but do not pretend January is optional.

title: Weekly outdoor outlook
text:
Data notes

Normals: 1991–2020 monthly averages for USW00094850.
Airport readings may differ from lakeshore or hilltop conditions.
Monday edits: open R/tasks.R and change only the wmw_manual_monday_tasks list at the top (hand-written tasks appear first). Leave it as list() to use the auto weather/season tasks. Then run quarto render monday.qmd or push to main and let Actions rebuild.
Auto rules (warmest/wettest/windiest day, week pattern, winter buck-up) live in the same file below the Monday hook.
